title: AI Techlead
description:
At a glance
Our AI team builds GenAI applications that go into production at one of the Netherlands' largest banks. Voice agents handling thousands of contact center calls. AI lending assistants supporting lenders in writing credit proposals. Agentic workflows that actually make it to users.
We don't stop at prototypes. We build, ship, measure, iterate, and do it fast. As an
AI Tech Lead
, you set the technical direction across these initiatives and stay close enough to the code to keep that pace honest. If you've got 7+ years of engineering experience, a serious track record of shipping AI in production, and you're looking to lead at a scale most companies won't give you for years, read on.
Your job
You set the technical direction on GenAI initiatives that span the bank: from the first conversation with a business team through to production and beyond. You decide how things get built, you build with the team, and you make sure the right things actually get done in a complex organisation. Your focus shifts with the use case: backend, frontend, from leveraging LLM’s to agentic. You own outcomes, not just architecture diagrams. You work directly with the people whose problems you're solving, and you bring the rest of the team along.
Concretely, you'll:
Set the technical direction for GenAI solutions across banking use cases: Voice AI, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, document intelligence.
Drive initiatives end-to-end through a complex organisation: align stakeholders, unblock teams, make the calls that need to be made.
Co-create use cases with business counterparts: you understand the problem, not just the technology, and you shape what gets built.
Stay hands-on: design and write the hard parts if required.
Own architecture and technical quality across multiple workstreams: trade-offs, patterns, what we standardise on, what we don't.
Work with Agents, plain LLMs, code, Databricks and whatever the right tool is for the job.
Raise the technical bar of the team: code reviews, design reviews, knowledge sharing, coaching mediors and juniors.
Working environment
You'll be part of a 25+ person AI team inside ABN AMRO's Innovation department. We operate with a startup mindset within a bank that serves millions of customers and employs thousands of individuals: fast feedback loops, direct lines to business leadership, and real deployment at scale. Amsterdam, hybrid.
Your profile
We don't hire on CV titles. We hire on what you've shipped and what you've led. The team includes people who came through software engineering, data science, infra — what they share is proven AI expertise and a bias for building over theorising. As a tech lead, you bring the same plus the ability to take an ambiguous problem and a group of strong engineers and turn it into something running in production.
What you've done:
Led the technical side of AI or software initiatives end-to-end: you've owned the architecture, made the hard calls, and shipped.
Built and deployed AI applications using LLMs, RAG, agents, fine-tuning, voice AI, or equivalent (at production scale, with real users).
Written Python that runs in production: you're a developer, not a notebook user, and you still enjoy writing the code.
Worked with cloud infrastructure: Azure preferred, AWS or GCP also fine.
Operated inside a complex organisation (or built the muscle elsewhere) and got things done across teams, not just within one.
How you work:
You take ambiguous problems, set a direction, and bring people with you (without waiting for permission).
You have strong technical opinions, formed through experience, and you're willing to defend them and change them.
You're as interested in the business problem as in the technical solution.
You explain your decisions clearly to people who don't share your context (engineers, business, leadership).
You follow the GenAI field closely because you're genuinely curious, not because you have to.
You've built something on the side (a tool, a project, a contribution) that shows you don't wait to be told what to learn.
We are offering
We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer:
An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36‑hour work week, including holiday allowance and a flexible benefit budget which adds up to a range of €65.000 to €93.000 a year based on a 36-hour week (40 hours possible, pro-rated)
An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.
Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work.
Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000.
An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.
You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy.
Interested?
No motivation letter. Please answer these two questions instead:
Tell us about an AI initiative you led: what did you build, what calls did you make as the technical lead, and what did you learn when it hit production (or real users)?
What's the most interesting thing you've built or experimented with in AI in the last six months? Why does it matter to you?
Applications without these answers will not be reviewed.
The recruitmentprocess consists of an online personality assessment, an online culture interview, a technical case and an offline technical Interview.

Banking for better, for generations to come.
" Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision of
being a personal bank in the digital age
aligns perfectly with the demand for surprising insights and innovative solutions, born from a diverse interplay of cultures and experiences. We focus on customer experience, sustainability, and building a future-proof bank, conducting annual reviews to ensure equal pay for equal work. Join a bank that embraces ingenuity and ambition, and make an impact with us for a better future.

title: Strategy Advisor - Data & AI
description:
At a glance
Bring your consulting toolkit. Stay to see the strategy become reality.
Move from advising organisations on Data & AI transformation to shaping and delivering it inside one of the Netherlands’ leading banks. You will work on high-priority strategic questions, influence enterprise decisions and remain involved as choices become roadmaps, operating models and measurable change.
Your job
Data and AI are changing customer expectations, business models and how organisations make decisions. For ABN AMRO, success requires clear strategic choices, enterprise-wide capabilities and responsible execution.
As Strategy Advisor - Data & AI, you will join the Governance & Strategy team within the Central Data & AI Office (CDAO). Working closely with the Chief Data & AI Officer and senior leaders, you will structure ambiguous questions, develop distinctive perspectives, create executive alignment and translate decisions into action. The role combines the intellectual challenge and variety of strategy consulting with sustained ownership of outcomes.
What you will do
Lead or shape strategic assignments at the intersection of business strategy, data, AI, technology, risk and regulation.
Turn complex analysis into clear choices, recommendations and decision-ready narratives for senior leadership.
Define enterprise direction, capability roadmaps and operating models for responsible Data & AI adoption.
Mobilise multidisciplinary teams across business lines, data domains, technology, risk, legal and compliance.
Assess market, technology and regulatory developments and translate them into implications for ABN AMRO.
Stay engaged beyond the recommendation, helping convert strategic decisions into priorities, ownership and executable change.
Questions you may help answer
Where can data and AI create meaningful and sustainable value for customers and the bank?
Which capabilities are needed to adopt generative and agentic AI responsibly and at scale?
How should accountabilities across business, data and technology work in a federated Data & AI landscape?
How can high-quality, well-governed data be made available for analytics and AI?
How should the bank use and govern unstructured data, including documents, text, voice and images?
How can ABN AMRO accelerate innovation while meeting regulatory, ethical, security and risk requirements?
Examples of assignments
Define the enterprise direction and capability roadmap for scaling generative and agentic AI responsibly.
Design accountabilities and an operating model for a strategic Data & AI capability.
Develop strategic choices, an investment case and a transformation roadmap for responsible use of unstructured data.
Assess an external technology or regulatory development and prepare clear choices for senior leadership.
What success looks like
Executives can make faster, better-informed decisions because choices and trade-offs are clear.
Business, technology, data, risk and governance align without losing strategic focus.
Strategic recommendations become funded roadmaps, accountable ownership and practical implementation.

Working environment
You will work within the Central Data & AI Office, Governance & Strategy, and collaborate with CDAO teams, IT, architecture, data domains, business lines, CISO, legal, compliance and risk. We value openness, constructive dialogue and professional curiosity. We aim to create an environment where people can speak up, learn from mistakes, combine different perspectives and help one another grow.

You are an experienced strategist or consultant who enjoys making sense of complexity. You combine analytical rigour with curiosity, sound judgment and a collaborative approach. You can challenge established thinking constructively, communicate with precision and adapt your story to executive, business and technical audiences.

Significant experience in strategy or management consulting, corporate strategy or a comparable internal advisory role.
A track record of structuring ambiguous enterprise questions and translating analysis into clear executive choices.
Experience advising senior decision-makers and aligning stakeholders with different perspectives.

title: Data Analist - Data Domain Customer Interaction & Engagement
description:
In het kort
Bij ABN AMRO bouwen we aan een persoonlijke bank in het digitale tijdperk. Customer Interactions & Engagement helpt klantbehoeften beter te begrijpen, soepele customer journeys te creëren en betekenisvolle klantervaringen op schaal te leveren. Data is daarbij essentieel: jij en je collega’s vertalen data naar duidelijke dashboards, werken nauw samen met stakeholders en gebruiken tools zoals PowerBI, SQL, Python en AI om inzichten en processen continu te verbeteren.
Je werk
Het team BI & Analytics Corporate Banking Clients is een van de centrale datateams van het Data Domain Customer Interaction & Engagement. Je aggregeert en combineert data uit verschillende bronnen—zowel intern als extern. Is de juiste data niet beschikbaar? Dan ontwerp je samen met de data engineer een manier om deze zelf te verkrijgen en te verzamelen.
Je maakt de data beschikbaar via op maat gemaakte dashboards, die je verrijkt met aansprekende layouts en trendanalyses. Deze solide basis ondersteunt jouw advies. Door voortdurend in gesprek te zijn met jouw stakeholders zorg je dat jouw informatie naadloos aansluit op de behoefte van de klant. Zo kunnen managers en klanten feitelijke beslissingen nemen en hun salesfunnel optimaliseren.
Werkomgeving
ABN AMRO is een toonaangevende bank in Nederland. Met diepgaande klant- en sectorkennis bieden we een breed scala aan producten en diensten—zowel standaard als op maat. We innoveren en verbeteren continu, gedreven door digitalisering, technologische ontwikkelingen en veranderende klantbehoeften.
Digitalisering is eveneens een belangrijk thema: ons doel is om klanten persoonlijk te bedienen via onze digitale kanalen. Hoe draagt jouw analyse daaraan bij?
Op ons hoofdkantoor in Amsterdam werk je samen met ongeveer tien andere data-analisten. Je team maakt deel uit van het Centre of Expertise BI & Data Analytics, waar zo’n 70 collega’s aan verschillende projecten werken. Het team werkt aan zowel kleine als grote projecten om onze klanten op de best mogelijke manier te bedienen met slimme oplossingen. Het is een open team met een goede sfeer, waar persoonlijke ontwikkeling sterk wordt gestimuleerd. Het team werkt hybride, doorgaans 2 tot 3 dagen op kantoor.
Je profiel
Je bent klantgericht, analytisch en nieuwsgierig, met een goed gevoel voor realiteit. Als ondernemer binnen de bank heb je de drive om zowel klantoplossingen als jezelf continu te verbeteren. Maar je verliest risico’s nooit uit het oog. Als teamplayer komt samenwerken voor jou vanzelf. Je werkt graag hard in een dynamische omgeving, maar kunt zaken ook goed relativeren wanneer dat nodig is.
Herken jij jezelf? Check je profiel:
3+ jaar relevante werkervaring
WO-werk- en denkniveau
Adviesvaardigheden
Uitstekende kennis en ervaring met BI-tools (PowerBI, DA100-certificering; ervaring met andere tools is een plus)
Kennis en ervaring met datapreparatie, datastores, datakwaliteit en data-analyse. Ervaring met SQL is essentieel
Ervaring met Databricks en Python is een plus
Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel in woord als geschrift
Wij bieden
Het is voor ons belangrijk om een goede werkgever te zijn. Wij bieden je daarom een functie met impact en uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden die bijdragen aan jouw werkplezier, ontwikkeling en wellbeing.
Daarnaast bieden wij:
Een aantrekkelijk bruto maandsalaris op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en een flexibel benefit budget.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling, zodat je goed voorbereid bent voor later.
Flexibiliteit in werken: thuiswerken is mogelijk in overleg met je team en afhankelijk van je functie. Wij regelen een ergonomische thuiswerkplek voor je.
Ruimte voor ontspanning met vijf weken vakantie per jaar, aangevuld met twee verplichte vrije dagen. Daarnaast kun je jaarlijks tot vier extra weken vakantie bijkopen.
Vijf ‘Banking for better days’: extra vrije dagen die je kunt inzetten voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling of vrijwilligerswerk.
Persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat centraal: je ontvangt een ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar,dat je kunt opsparen tot €3.000.
Een OV-jaarabonnement met gratis openbaar vervoer in heel Nederland voor zakelijk en privégebruik.
Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en salarisschalen vind je in onze
cao
die van toepassing is op deze vacature.
Voor deze functie zoeken we een kandidaat op schaal 9 of 10. Op basis van jouw ervaring, expertise en potentieel bepalen we samen de uiteindelijke inschaling.
Interesse?
Ben je geïnteresseerd? Reageer dan op deze vacature. We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten.
Jouw Toekomst: Inclusief, Innovatief en Duurzaam
Bij ABN AMRO geloven we in "
Banking for better, for generations to come.
" Gelijke kansen voor iedereen vormen een belangrijk fundament, waarbij we streven naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin alle medewerkers zich gezien, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Onze visie als
persoonlijke bank in de digitale tijd
sluit naadloos aan bij de behoefte aan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen, voortkomend uit een divers samenspel van culturen en ervaringen. We richten ons op klantbeleving, duurzaamheid en bouwen aan een toekomstbestendige bank, waarbij we gelijke beloning voor gelijk werk jaarlijks onderzoeken om eerlijke kansen te waarborgen. Sluit je aan bij een bank die vindingrijkheid en ambitie omarmt, en maak samen met ons impact voor een betere toekomst.

Gebruik van AI tijdens sollicitatieproces
Je mag AI gebruiken om je cv en motivatiebrief te schrijven, zolang het jouw eigen verhaal blijft en laat zien wie jij bent. We kijken met aandacht naar elke sollicitatie en doen dat altijd persoonlijk, zonder AI. Tijdens gesprekken is het gebruik van real time AI niet toegestaan. title: Data Analist - Client Integrity (ICS)
description:
In het kort
International Card Services (ICS) is een betalingsdienstverlener en marktleider op het gebied van het uitgeven van creditcards in Nederland. We zijn een 100% dochteronderneming van ABN AMRO Bank N.V. Een stabiel en betrouwbaar systeem is voor onze klanten essentieel. Om onze positie verder te versterken en bij te dragen aan onze missie, zijn we op zoek naar een Data Analist die helpt bij het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van rapportages en dashboards die inzicht bieden in Client Integrity en bijdragen aan datagedreven besluitvorming.
Je werk
Je ontwikkelt rapportages en dashboards, analyseert data en gaat samen met stakeholders op zoek naar antwoorden op uiteenlopende vraagstukken.
Vertalen van complexe data-inzichten naar concrete, begrijpelijke adviezen voor management en stakeholders. Je rapporteert bijvoorbeeld over trends en geeft aanbevelingen voor optimalisering van operationele regels op basis van jouw analyses.
Je verdiept je in processen, stelt kritische vragen en probeert te begrijpen wat er achter de cijfers schuil gaat.
Daarnaast denk je mee over hoe rapportages, datasets en teamprocessen slimmer en efficiënter kunnen worden ingericht. We zoeken iemand die niet alleen uitvoert, maar ook kansen ziet en initiatief neemt om verbeteringen aan te dragen.
Werkomgeving
Je komt te werken in het Data Office, waar we data omzetten in inzichten die helpen om betere beslissingen te nemen en de organisatie verder te ontwikkelen. Vijf teams werken hier dagelijks aan één missie: data inzetten als strategisch vermogen. Je zal komen te werken in het Client Integrity Reporting team. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor alle MI (Management Informatie) met betrekking tot Client Integrity, waaronder KYC, SIRA, SIM en Transactie Monitoring. We bouwen rapportages, beantwoorden complexe vragen vanuit de business en helpen collega's om data beter te begrijpen en te gebruiken.
Jij brengt structuur in de chaos. Je vertaalt vragen en ideeën vanuit de business naar heldere analyses en bruikbare inzichten. The Senior Consultant Systems Architect is a recognized expert in systems architecting and systems engineering who combines deep technical expertise with a strong affinity for research, innovation, and industrial impact. In this role, you contribute to the creation, validation, and deployment of next-generation systems engineering and architecting methodologies, helping organizations engineer increasingly complex systems in a more effective and predictable manner.
Working at the intersection of research and industrial practice, you collaborate with researchers, architects, engineers, and industry partners to transform scientific knowledge into practical engineering approaches, methods, and tools. Through innovation and collaboration projects at TNO-ESI, you contribute to strengthening the engineering capabilities of organizations in the High-Tech Equipment, Energy, Mission Critical Infrastructure, and Defense sectors while advancing the competitiveness of Dutch industry and addressing important societal challenges.
What will be your role?
At TNO-ESI, we bridge the gap between research and industrial practice. Our mission is to develop and embed advanced systems engineering methodologies, tools, and expertise in industry, enabling organizations to engineer increasingly complex systems more effectively. By scaling the adoption of these innovations, TNO-ESI contributes to the competitiveness of Dutch industry and helps address major societal challenges such as the energy transition, digitalization, and sustainable high-tech innovation.
As a Senior Consultant Systems Architect, you will contribute to advancing the state of practice in systems engineering and architecting by connecting industrial challenges with scientific research. Working closely with industrial partners, researchers, architects, and engineers, you will help identify emerging complexity challenges, evaluate and validate new methodologies, and support their adoption in industrial environments. Through this work, you will contribute to both the relevance of TNO-ESI's research portfolio and the engineering effectiveness of organizations operating in complex domains.

Helping organizations tackle complex system development challenges by analyzing technical and organizational bottlenecks and identifying practical, scalable solutions using systems engineering and architecting principles.

Leading consultancy and innovation projects in collaboration with industrial partners, researchers, and multidisciplinary teams, ensuring that project outcomes result in measurable and lasting impact.
Contributing to the development, validation, and continuous improvement of systems engineering and architecting methodologies within TNO-ESI, based on both research outcomes and industrial experience.
Identifying emerging challenges and innovation opportunities in industry and translating them into new research topics, collaborative programs, and innovation initiatives that strengthen TNO-ESI's impact and relevance.

title: Scientist Underwater Communications
description:
About this position
Would you like to develop wireless ‘underwater internet’ together with your colleagues? Plan and evaluate operations with underwater drones? Come and work at TNO as a scientist in underwater communications!
In today’s unpredictable geopolitical climate, safeguarding our society is crucial. TNO, as a knowledge institute, plays a vital role in the ecosystem with about a thousand highly educated employees specialising in innovations for Defence & Security. Here, you can actively contribute to a safer world, both nationally and at a European level.
The Acoustics and Underwater Warfare division brings together all acoustic expertise within TNO and primarily works for the Royal Navy. The Underwater Operations & Seabed Security department focuses on research and development in the field of autonomous underwater systems. Applications include detecting sea mines with autonomous underwater and surface drones, 'stand-off' submarine combat, wireless underwater (network) communication, or protecting critical infrastructure on the seabed. We develop state-of-the-art acoustic sensor systems, including advanced data processing algorithms for communication, visualisation and information extraction to generate situational awareness.
What will be your role?
As a medior scientist in underwater communications, you will work on multiple projects to develop innovative solutions for our clients, often including the Ministry of Defence. Each project has its own team with whom you work closely, and because no project is ever the same, you will have plenty of opportunities to develop further.
Depending on your background and preferences, you may be involved with:
Improving algorithms for acoustic and optical underwater communications on various layers of the OSI model.
Research into optimising communications within networks of autonomous (underwater) nodes and drones.
Designing, setting up, and carrying out experiments, both through realistic simulations and measurements in the laboratory or at sea.
Reporting and presenting results to Defence, peers, and colleagues.
Are you someone who enjoys working in a team and is looking for a role where you contribute to society? This job offers variety and stimulates your personal growth as a scientist.
What we expect from you
In addition to being enthusiastic about the work we do, you recognise yourself in the following profile:
You have at least an MSc in electrical engineering and/or computer science.
You have experience or a specialisation in telecommunications and signal processing, including experience with algorithm development.
You have knowledge of modulations, network protocols and architectures.
Preferably, you already have several years of experience in (applied) research.
You are proactive and assertive; you feel responsible for the final result and ensure that things get done.
You communicate clearly and convincingly in English, verbally and in writing.
You are able to work in an international and military context, such as in European or NATO projects.
You are open to new ideas, eager to learn, and help others to learn in turn.
Reactions from junior or senior candidates are also welcome.
What you'll get in return
Challenging and varied work with a real impact. And plenty of opportunities as, at TNO, you are in charge of shaping your career. We offer a gross monthly salary (based on your knowledge and experience), 8% holiday pay, a 13
th
